Hi Emma — Ben from Security & Trust here. Short answers up-front, details below:

- SOC 2 Type II: we have a Type II report covering the period 2024-10-01 to 2025-10-01 (attached as soc2-typeii-2024.pdf). We can provide the report and a redacted cover letter if you need one for procurement.
- Bridge letter: attaching a standard temporary bridge letter (bridge-letter-20261201.pdf) that covers known changes while the next audit completes.
- KMS / CMEK: hosted runtime supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and GCP CMEK for both data at rest and backups. For our managed hosted tier we offer CMEK integration; for Dedicated/Private deployments we can integrate with your KMS/HSM directly.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood does offer a BAA; legal will need to approve standard terms. BAAs are available for Hosted Dedicated and Private deployments — we will mark this as high priority.
- Scope: Production (and snapshots/backups) are included in our SOC scope by default; we can provide a scoped statement if you need production-only text.
- SSO / SAML: SAML 2.0 + SCIM provisioning supported; IP allowlist and org-level SSO are available.

Next steps (technical)
1) We’ll upload the SOC 2 and bridge letter to the Trust Portal and share a one-time invite link (Marissa will send).
2) If you prefer, I can pre-fill parts of your DSQ and flag items where we need customer input.
3) For CMEK we’ll need a short technical call (30 mins) to exchange key ARNs and confirm encryption-at-rest workflows — propose Thu 12/3 10am PT.

Attachments: soc2-typeii-2024.pdf, bridge-letter-20261201.pdf

If you want the redacted report earlier, tell me which sections you need redacted and I’ll produce a copy for procurement.

—Ben
